transcript:
User: I want to be upfront: the last marketing agency strung me along for three months and I got nothing. Why would you be different?
Agent: Got it — that’s frustrating, and honestly we hear that a lot.  

So… before I answer that, what were you specifically hoping that agency would deliver in those three months — more calls, booked appointments, something else?
User: I expected more booked appointments and fewer missed calls. They promised results but disappeared after getting my payment.
Agent: Yeah… that makes sense, and I don’t blame you for being skeptical after that.  

When you say “fewer missed calls,” what’s actually happening at your practice right now — are calls going to voicemail while you’re with patients, or is it more after-hours that slip through?
User: It's mostly during office hours when we're busy with patients, and we can't always get to the phone.
Agent: Mhm, got it — so the phone’s ringing while you’re in the middle of treating patients, and those calls just… slip to voicemail or get missed.  

On a typical busy day, how many calls would you guess don’t get answered live?
User: About 18 calls a week go unanswered, which could've been potential bookings.
Agent: Yeah, 18 missed calls a week is a lot — especially when those could’ve been patients on your schedule.  

When those calls go to voicemail during office hours, do people usually call you back later, or do you feel like many just move on to another practice?
User: Honestly, most don't call back. It's frustrating knowing we're losing potential patients because of it.
Agent: Yeah, I hear you — that’s not just frustrating, that’s real money and real patients slipping away every week.  

Has anyone ever walked you through what those 18 missed calls a week actually add up to in lost revenue?
User: Not exactly, but I know it's significant. What can you do to make sure we don't miss those calls?
Agent: Makes sense — you already feel the hit even without the numbers on paper.  

So, at a high level, we put a system in place that answers those office-hour calls instantly when your team can’t pick up, books the appointment, and sends it into your workflow so those “18 missed calls” become actual patients — would you be open to doing a quick back-of-the-envelope math first, just to see what that’s really worth to you each week?
User: Sure, but what happens after I sign up? I don't want to be left hanging again.
Agent: Yeah, totally fair — you don’t want another “thanks for your money, good luck” situation.  

So… day to day, the difference with us is that our system actually answers those office-hour calls you miss, books the patient, and sends it straight to you without needing more staff — can I ask, after that agency experience, what would make you feel confident that things are really working within, say, the first month?
User: I need to see real-time results and know I won't be abandoned after the initial setup.
Agent: Got it — you want two things: to actually *see* calls turning into bookings in real time, and to know there’s someone still there after it’s turned on.  

So… if you had a system that showed you every answered call, every booked patient, and a simple weekly report on “calls saved,” would that be enough transparency, or do you need more hands-on check‑ins from us in that first month?
User: Sounds promising, but I'm cautious. Could I witness a live call turning into a booking before deciding?
Agent: Yeah, that makes total sense — you want to *see* it, not take anyone’s word for it.  

What we do is a 20‑minute walkthrough where Jay actually shows you live calls turning into bookings, plus the dashboard with real-time results; would you be open to doing that sometime this week so you can see it in action before you decide?
User: Okay... one demo. But I'm watching closely. And remember, I'm in Mountain/Phoenix time.
Agent: Makes sense — we’ll earn your trust on that demo.  

Quick check before we look at times: what’s your first name?
User: Bianca. Looking forward to seeing this in action, but I’ll be scrutinizing every detail.
Agent: Got it, Bianca — that’s exactly the level of scrutiny we like.  

Next thing I need: what’s the name of your practice?
User: It's Cole Family Dental. Just make sure everything is clear and transparent before we proceed any further.
Agent: Got it, Bianca — we’ll keep everything straightforward and visible.  

One moment while I check availability… would you prefer doing that demo later today or tomorrow?
User: Tomorrow works better for me. Just ensure it's within Mountain/Phoenix time, please.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: Bianca, you’re all set for tomorrow at 9:00 in your Mountain/Phoenix time — Jay will walk you through live calls turning into bookings for Cole Family Dental. You’ll get an SMS confirmation with all the details and a link to reschedule if you ever need to. Is there anything else I can help you with before we wrap up?
